question: In a code language, 'SLAIN' is written as ‘PKCNU’ and 'DENT' is written as 'VPGF'. How will 'CUBOID' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series diagonally.

​So,

 
• 'SLAIN' is written as ‘PKCNU’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74b203c80c97997fb5c4cf04d24fc731e63e5e29d84e4227fc6248294d4b7009.png] 

And,

 
• 'DENT' is written as 'VPGF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0179683bfb0c3174ed6eb8907d99e40b3308f5def602ed8be0b6d82d071b27ed.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'CUBOID' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ab754bb91615a104021a68f36fac6acecde8151da6f1f758b5426fdaca8b32d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****FKQDWE**".
